**Status:** UNPUBLISHED / DRAFT-ONLY / COMMERCIAL HARD HOLD · 2026-11-06
**Owner:** Mind & Affiliate Studio; coordination only with Grok/Praxxis TASK-008, Dispatch #174, Site QA #126, homepage art lead #150, and conversion charter #820.
**Do not edit:** homepage PR #49, canonical /mind/ hub PR #172, Issue #150 owned branch, Jetpack list/Focus welcome, production WordPress menus/content, merchant accounts or Grok queue.

## 1. Commercial decision before more creative production

**Primary commercial hypothesis:** Visitors searching “Zen12 Premium review,” “Zen12 MP3 what is included,” or “12-minute meditation vs ordinary practice” may have greater purchase intent than visitors who simply enjoyed an illusion video. Give these prospective buyers an independent, exact-offer assessment and the choice of a free alternative. The proposed test is a *decision guide*, not a promise of benefit.

**Exact seller inspected 2026-11-06:** https://inspire3.com/ and https://zen12.com/ . Seller displayed Premium $87.99, 12 levels, 48 MP3 files, guide/support/bonuses, and advertised 1-year guarantee. This is a **dated seller display** and not a verified final checkout, price available to FV traffic, refund fulfillment or endorsement. Promotional pricing on other seller routes may differ. No discount or urgency language belongs in FV copy. The listed audio-entrainment and twelve-minutes-equals-an-hour promises remain **unsubstantiated for the actual product**. Generic binaural-beat or mindfulness research cannot validate them.

**Independent contrast:** The official https://brainwaveshots.com/focus-shot describes a *different* product: Focus Shot with 15/30-minute audio, brainwave-only files and technical frequencies; its page displayed $17.99 on 2026-11-06. Its focus outcome is also a seller claim. The R168 seller comparison is for accurate audience fit, **not** an active second offer, cross-sell or approved partner creative.

**Authorization and fallbacks:** A public partner registration page https://affiliates.inspire3.com/ is not an individualized acceptance record. Gmail searched for Inspire3/Zen12/Hypnosis Live/Brainwave Shots account-approval messages on 2026-11-06 and showed promotional/editorial correspondence; no verified approval or exact earning URL. This cannot establish denial, and dashboard approval remains uninspected. The paid FV-owned Mind Payhip SKU, its rights, checkout, price, refund terms and delivery are also unverified. **Neither an affiliate paid CTA nor a purported owned-paid checkout can lawfully be activated based on current evidence.** The only active action in the unpublished preview is the established free /focus/ destination. No new Jetpack form.

### Founder-authorized unlock checklist (all gates necessary, none presumed)
1. Provide authenticated Inspire3 acceptance and merchant-specific rights to feature Zen12, web/social/email allowed placements, affiliate tracking URL and cookie/attribution reporting terms, and approved creative terms; *or* demonstrate a rights-cleared and genuinely purchasable FV-owned Mind SKU in authenticated Payhip with tested checkout and fulfillment.
2. Independently inspect actual customer checkout charge, offer version and return terms. Do not present an observed landing price as guaranteed final price.
3. Authorize and complete staging QA on both text-only and optional-video render, including disabled-by-default merchant control, link destination, clear adjacent disclosure, keyboard, screen reader, 360/390/768/1440/1920 px, WCAG contrast, CWV and mobile.
4. Founder separately approves commercial release, link activation and any campaign or analytics changes. No release inferred from code review or earlier homepage approvals.

## 3. Landing action hierarchy and off-site safeguards

The R168 unpublished HTML offers:
- A clear research hook and original readable waveform graphic (not an EEG trace).
- A useful no-purchase thought experiment.
- An exact Zen12 Premium feature/limitation guide; buyer objections and free alternatives.
- A **disabled native button** labeled partner authorization not verified (not an `<a>`, no click handler, no merchant URL).
- FTC-ready plain-language future commission disclosure **adjacent to the button**: “If you purchase through an affiliate link, Final Vestige may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.” Also says that no link is active and no present partnership is implied.
- One existing free Focus Fieldbook link; no extra subscription list.
- Original 42s poster, narration, timing and transcript *concept*. **No video file** and no experimental exposure.

A buyer who arrives directly must be able to read the science and leave without an email. The editor's conclusion must not change based on whether FV eventually receives commission. A prospective earning link should use appropriate `rel="sponsored noopener noreferrer"` and destination/label review, never an undisclosed redirect, if and only if the release gates open.

## 4. Controlled A/B hypothesis: text-only versus optional 42s original video

**H0:** Addition of a lightweight optional, human-captioned 42-second original video does not change verified net revenue per 1,000 *qualified human* sessions relative to the otherwise identical text guide. **H1 (directional pilot):** Optional video increases comprehension and qualified buyer decisions enough to improve net revenue without compromising performance, trust or accessibility.

**A:** exact-offer review with sources, free alternative, disabled (until authorized) or authorized buying action; no video block.

**B:** the same wording and identical CTA/disclosure plus optional native `<video controls preload="none" poster="...">`, an authored WebVTT caption file, accurate text transcript and no autoplay. Do not ship just a YouTube embed or heavy third-party script. Video poster and compressed media must fit agreed LCP limits. B remains fully useful if media fails or JS is disabled.

**Design:** Only after offer/release approvals, implement a first-party server/edge assignment with documented randomization, not a cosmetic UTM split by creator topic. Avoid invasive fingerprinting. If privacy review disallows stable pseudonymous assignment, report repeat-visit contamination as a limitation rather than smuggling tracking in. Pre-register campaign eligibility, 7/30-day cohort windows, conversion definitions, stop rules and an A/A baseline. Do not call changes significant until adequately powered, and explicitly disclose tiny samples. **A/B is NOT RUN; native media does not yet exist.** With the merchant link disabled, a checkout/revenue test cannot be performed, although static usability can be QA'd.

## 5. Privacy-safe measurement and reconciliation contract

Do not install duplicate analytics scripts. First inspect existing WordPress/Jetpack/approved analytics and #820 instrumentation proposals. Suggested first-party data dictionary for engineering and QA:

| Event | Truth source | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `campaign_landing` (`utm_source`, `utm_medium=organic_social`, `utm_campaign=mind_pilot_2026_11`, `utm_content=real_asset_id`) | Approved site logs/analytics, filtered for qualified human sessions | Landing, **not a purchase** |
| `article_to_resource_click` | First-party aggregate event; do not track identity | Free CTA interaction, **not subscription** |
| `confirmed_focus_signup` | Existing Jetpack confirmed state where supported, privacy/consent-reviewed; no duplicate list | Confirmed lead only; unknown if unavailable |
| `affiliate_click` / `affiliate_outbound` | First-party outbound event after approval | Off-site click, **not merchant purchase** |
| `verified_paid_order` | Authenticated Payhip order/partner merchant sale report and refund status | Sale only when independently reconciled |
| `settled_net_revenue` | Merchant settlements less eligible fees, returns, refunds, reversals | Money actually realized, not predicted commission |

Do not store email address, IP, device fingerprint, cross-site identifiers, individualized listening history or unconsented tracking in a custom event stream. Normalize campaign IDs without leaking referral parameters to third-party embedded media. Mark attribution missing when platform bio links, multiple sessions or private merchant reporting prevent a defensible join.

**Primary KPI (only with verified denominator and numerator):**

`Owned Payhip net/1k = 1000 × (FV-owned receipts actually settled − processor/platform fees − refunds/chargebacks − incremental fulfillment costs not already withheld) / qualified human sessions`. **Affiliate net/1k = 1000 × (FV's partner commissions actually settled and attributable − FV-borne fees − partner clawbacks/refunds not already netted in those settlements) / qualified human sessions**. Merchant gross merchandise value is NOT FV's affiliate revenue. Never subtract a fee or reversal twice from an already net settlement.

The net revenue must be attributable to the *same defined cohort* with documented 7/30-day follow-through and partner settlement lag. Also show paid order conversion, independently confirmed order count, lead-to-paid rate only where observable, refund rate, gross/net revenue and content hours. If `Q` or net settlements are unknown, the KPI is **NOT COMPUTABLE**—never zero by default. A held partner link means no possible affiliate measurement test yet. Avoid assuming an affiliate click yielded a commission or that a checkout start equaled a paid order.
